date_policy: Original note creation, UTC repository creation, and documentation updates are distinguished. Store dates record availability, not exact publication.

projects.name: Chroma Portal
projects.summary: Two hands define a four-corner window over a camera feed and reveal a psychedelic color treatment inside it.
projects.requirements: Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe and NumPy; TouchDesigner for the GLSL route.
projects.limits: Eight automated checks passed. Live webcam and native TouchDesigner testing remain pending. No .toe or .tox binary is included.
includes: Python hand tracking and OpenCV reference compositor
TouchDesigner GLSL shader and localhost RGB/control bridge
Optional OSC controls, setup guide, reference screenshots and validation notes
projects.image_caption: Synthetic test render from the starter code, not a live camera recording.

projects.name: Mouth Wah Mini
projects.summary: Turn jaw movement into an expressive guitar wah with an editable TouchDesigner builder.
projects.requirements: TouchDesigner, a webcam, audio interface, NumPy and the separately installed MediaPipe TouchDesigner plugin. OpenCV is optional for the overlay.
projects.limits: Source/prototype edition. No native VST3 or DAW plugin is included. Simulated control/DSP checks are documented; live routing and tracking depend on your setup.
includes: Project setup guide and parameter documentation
projects.image_caption: Guitar and TouchDesigner workspace from the shared Mouth Wah / Finger Fuzz repository.

projects.name: Mini Finger Fuzz 001
projects.summary: The original guitar-patch drop with a WAV sample, demo, and illustrated quick-start guide.
projects.requirements: TouchDesigner and an audio interface for live guitar.
projects.limits: Existing original release. See the Patreon listing for the included files and setup.
includes: WAV sample, MP4 demo and illustrated quick-start guide
projects.image_caption: Recorded preview from the shared guitar-effects workspace; dated November 6, 2026 in the repository.

projects.name: FFT Wah Study
projects.summary: Explore spectral wah filtering, FFT reconstruction checks, and a note/chord visualizer.
projects.requirements: TouchDesigner with NumPy; OpenCV for the rendered visualizer. Audio input/output devices for live use.
projects.limits: Experimental source kit. Native TouchDesigner and Windows audio/device execution has not been verified here. No standalone plugin or finished .tox is supplied.
includes: Complete fft_wah_lab Python builders and callbacks
Note/chord analysis, color map, and synthetic preview
Numerical tests and detailed setup/checking guide
projects.image_caption: FFT wah callback screenshot from the guitar-effects repository.

projects.name: Live Captions
projects.summary: Add local microphone captions to a TouchDesigner performance or streaming scene.
projects.requirements: Windows x64, Python 3.11 recommended, TouchDesigner, microphone, and first-run internet access to install Vosk/sounddevice and download a model.
projects.limits: Local prototype. Windows microphone and native TouchDesigner checks remain setup-dependent. English is the default; captions are not guaranteed accurate. No radio recordings, speech model, or third-party packages are bundled.
projects.image_caption: Live-caption workspace screenshot dated November 6, 2026 in the repository.

projects.name: Chord Radiance
projects.summary: Play a polyphonic keyboard instrument that turns notes into color and chords into a glowing visual.
projects.requirements: TouchDesigner. No extra packages or assets required.
projects.limits: Checked in TouchDesigner 2023.12370 on macOS for mapping, finite audio data, rendering, and reload. Physical speaker playback was not listened to. This is a keyboard instrument, not a guitar chord-recognition plugin.
projects.image_caption: Chord Radiance C-major chord-glow preview from the component repository.

projects.name: MediaPipe + Camera
projects.summary: A compact calibration toolkit for turning an existing camera-tracking channel into a stable 0–1 creative control.
projects.requirements: Python 3 for the math helper. For live tracking: your own webcam, TouchDesigner and the separately installed upstream MediaPipe plugin.
projects.limits: This is an original mapping helper and guide, not the MediaPipe plugin, a tracker model, or a prebuilt .tox. No OBS/phone-camera setup service is included.
includes: calibration.py with finite-value checks, clamping, smoothing, and tracking-loss behavior
projects.image_caption: Historical camera-routing study. The Patreon calibration helper is a separate source-kit edition.

projects.name: Finger Colorshift
projects.summary: Map a normalized finger position to a circular hue palette for your own visuals.
projects.requirements: Python 3 for the mapper. TouchDesigner and your separately installed tracker for live gesture input.
projects.limits: Source-only starter edition. No camera tracker, historical .toe, full feedback composition, or prebuilt .tox is included. The mapping math is checked; live TouchDesigner integration is not verified.
projects.image_caption: Historical finger-tracking workspace. The Patreon product contains the gesture-to-color mapping starter.

projects.name: Network Layout
projects.summary: A reusable planning template for readable TouchDesigner patches and clean handoffs.
projects.requirements: Python 3 to regenerate the diagram, and a browser to view it. No TouchDesigner installation required to use the planning templates.
projects.limits: Planning/template edition. It does not automatically reorganize or modify an existing .toe file. The original project screenshot is a reference, not an editable network.
includes: Python generator for a local HTML node-layout map
projects.image_caption: Historical network-layout screenshot. The downloadable planning template does not reorganize this patch.

projects.name: The Signal Attic
projects.summary: An editable interactive browser studio with orbit controls, scene modes, object movement, and exports.
projects.requirements: A modern browser. WebGL for the primary renderer; the included canvas fallback is more limited.
projects.limits: Existing source/demo edition. RTX/OpenUSD assets, NVIDIA certification, custom scenes, website integration, and hosting are not included.
includes: Standalone world.html with WebGL and canvas fallback
Local launch instructions and editable source
projects.image_caption: Signal Attic browser screenshot, showing the Canvas fallback renderer. Screenshot indexed November 9, 2026.

projects.name: Keeks the Geek
projects.summary: Build from an authored-note chatbot demo and an experimental QLoRA training/evaluation pipeline.
projects.requirements: Browser and Python for demo use. Compatible NVIDIA/CUDA/PyTorch environment and separately acquired compute/model dependencies for training.
projects.limits: No trained model or adapter is included. The browser retrieves starter notes; it does not generate answers with a fine-tuned model. GPU execution and quality improvement are unverified.
includes: Training/validation data, source catalogs and Colab notebook
projects.image_caption: Keeks browser demo screenshot. This shows the authored-note interface, not a trained-model evaluation.
